content: {"praised":["Masterpiece with claustrophobic tension and long continuous takes.","Psychological thriller showcasing clever manipulation of audience expectations.","Strong thematic exploration of ego, impulse, and moral decay.","Effective use of confined setting enhances suspense.","Excellent direction by Hitchcock, elevating the story."],"criticized":["Acting by Jimmy Stewart considered weak and unconvincing.","Story lacks clear punishment, leaving moral ambiguity.","Philosophical tone off-putting, making it hard to engage.","Early part of film feels preachy and disconcerting.","Plot criticized for being too dark and unsettling."]}
